name: Cup of Tea
desc: Hot, sweet and strangely effective. Restores 20 HP.

name: Flask of Tea
desc: Somebody's gran packed this. Restores 60 HP and a sense of calm.

name: Bakewell Tart
desc: It's a tart, not a pudding. Restores 10 PP to every move.

name: Buxton Water
desc: Filtered through miles of limestone. Cures every status.

name: Smelling Salts
desc: One sniff and you're wide awake and fully aware of your surroundings.

name: Kendal Mint Cake
desc: Fuel for fell walkers. Revives a fainted creature at half HP.

name: Bara Brith
desc: Tea-soaked fruit loaf, butter optional, opinions compulsory. Restores 60 HP.

name: Scouse
desc: Lamb stew, bread and a healthy dose of Liverpool attitude. Restores 80 HP.

name: Eccles Cake
desc: Flaky pastry, currants and a bit of Lancashire smugness. Cures chills, muddles, stings and sleep.

name: Soda Bread
desc: No yeast, no fuss, and a cross cut in the top to let the fairies out. Restores 70 HP.

name: Barmbrack
desc: Fruit loaf with a ring hidden inside. Whoever finds the ring gets a year of luck. Restores 120 HP.

name: Pasty
desc: Crimped on the side, never on the top, and only ever eaten on a windy cliff. Restores 100 HP.

name: Cream Tea
desc: Scone, jam, clotted cream and a fierce argument about whether the jam goes on first. Restores all HP.
